notes: EBIT in this package is set equal to GAAP “income from operations” from ResMed’s consolidated financial statements (used to compute EBIT margin). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/943819/000094381925000083/rmd-20250630x10k_ars.pdf))

NWC construction: NWC = (Total current assets − Cash and cash equivalents) − (Total current liabilities − Short-term debt, net). FY2023 uses the June 30, 2023 balance sheet from ResMed’s FY2024 annual report; FY2024–FY2025 uses the June 30 balance sheets from ResMed’s FY2025 10-K. ([investor.resmed.com](https://investor.resmed.com/sec-filings/annual-reports/content/0000943819-24-000013/rmd-20240630.htm))

Comps multiples use StockAnalysis “EV / Sales” and “EV / EBITDA” as proxies for EV/NTM Revenue and EV/NTM EBITDA (forward/NTM definitions may differ by provider). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/phg/statistics/))

NOL utilization percent is not explicitly disclosed in the filings; NOL balance is set to the disclosed U.S. + non-U.S. net operating loss carryforwards (~$14.4 million total). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/943819/000094381925000083/rmd-20250630x10k_ars.pdf))
WACC is an assumption (not directly disclosed as a single consolidated figure in the filing); set to 0.085 base case for DCF inputs and adjusted modestly in bull/bear scenarios.

catalysts: Sustained demand for sleep/breathing devices and consumables (masks/accessories) supporting incremental revenue growth. ([investor.resmed.com](https://investor.resmed.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-029326/0001193125-26-029326.pdf))

Acceleration in digital health/connected-care adoption, including AI-enabled product clearances and continued ecosystem scaling. ([investor.resmed.com](https://investor.resmed.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-029326/0001193125-26-029326.pdf))

Integration progress from VirtuOx and related operational execution affecting margins and cash generation. ([investor.resmed.com](https://investor.resmed.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-029326/0001193125-26-029326.pdf))
company_overview: ResMed reports two operating segments: Sleep and Breathing Health (therapy-based devices/masks and related offerings) and Residential Care Software (cloud/SaaS for residential care providers). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/943819/000094381925000083/rmd-20250630x10k_ars.pdf))

The company markets products in more than 140 countries through a mix of distributors and direct sales. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/943819/000094381925000083/rmd-20250630x10k_ars.pdf))

Fiscal 2025 performance showed revenue of $5,146.3 million and GAAP income from operations of $1,685.4 million. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/943819/000094381925000083/rmd-20250630x10k_ars.pdf))
current_context: In Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended Dec 31, 2025), revenue grew to $1,422.8 million (+11% YoY headline; +9% constant currency) with gross margin up to 61.8%. ([investor.resmed.com](https://investor.resmed.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-029326/0001193125-26-029326.pdf))

Income from operations increased 18% YoY and operating cash flow was $340 million in the quarter. ([investor.resmed.com](https://investor.resmed.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-029326/0001193125-26-029326.pdf))

ResMed highlighted ongoing investment to scale digital health and noted additional SG&A related to the VirtuOx acquisition and employee/marketing/technology investments. ([investor.resmed.com](https://investor.resmed.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-029326/0001193125-26-029326.pdf))
investment_highlights: Base case assumes ResMed sustains high-single-digit revenue growth into FY2026 before moderating toward low-to-mid single digits, consistent with recent execution. ([investor.resmed.com](https://investor.resmed.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-029326/0001193125-26-029326.pdf))

EBIT margin is modeled around the recent ~33% GAAP operating profitability level, reflecting continued operating leverage (gross margin expansion and controlled opex). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/943819/000094381925000083/rmd-20250630x10k_ars.pdf))

Capital intensity is kept moderate (modeled capex at ~1.7%–1.85% of sales), consistent with historical capex levels derived from cash flow. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/943819/000094381925000083/rmd-20250630x10k_ars.pdf))

Working capital needs are modeled using an NWC-as-%-of-sales normalization around ~26%, with explicit treatment of receivables/inventory vs payables/accruals and customer consideration timing. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/943819/000094381925000083/rmd-20250630x10k_ars.pdf))
key_risks: Reimbursement and healthcare procurement dynamics could reduce device/mask volumes or pricing. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/943819/000094381925000083/rmd-20250630x10k_ars.pdf))

Manufacturing, supply chain, or quality/regulatory issues could pressure gross margin and/or increase costs. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/943819/000094381925000083/rmd-20250630x10k_ars.pdf))

Working-capital swings (customer payment terms, inventory levels, deferred revenue recognition) could affect free cash flow conversion. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/943819/000094381925000083/rmd-20250630x10k_ars.pdf))

presentation.subtitle: ResMed (RMD): Base-case DCF + medical-device comps
valuation_summary: DCF base-case uses FY2023–FY2025 historicals (revenue, GAAP income from operations as EBIT proxy, D&A, and capex) to anchor operating structure and reinvestment assumptions. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/943819/000094381925000083/rmd-20250630x10k_ars.pdf))
Terminal value is computed with a balanced terminal approach (average method) and economically conservative terminal growth (3%).

Peer multiples are included as a sanity check using EV/Sales, EV/EBITDA, and forward P/E from medical-tech large caps as proxies for NTM-style multiples. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/bsx/statistics/))
